actions.name: UPPERCASE
actions.description: Converts the selected text to UPPERCASE. Requires a text selection.

actions.name: lowercase
actions.description: Converts the selected text to lowercase. Requires a text selection.

actions.name: Title Case
actions.description: Converts the selected text to Title Case. Requires a text selection.

actions.name: snake_case
actions.description: Converts the selected text to snake_case. Requires a text selection.

actions.name: camelCase
actions.description: Converts the selected text to camelCase. Requires a text selection.

actions.name: Clear YAML Blocks
actions.description: Scans the entire document and removes all YAML code blocks, including the ```yaml fences and their content.

actions.name: Copy Next YAML Content
actions.description: Finds the first YAML block below the cursor and copies its full content to the clipboard (excludes fences).

actions.name: Clear YAML Values
actions.description: Preserves the YAML structure (fences and keys) but deletes all values after the colons and list markers, across all YAML blocks.

actions.name: Copy Next YAML Values
actions.description: Finds the first YAML block below the cursor and copies only the values (as-is, no bracket stripping).

actions.name: Wrap in ''
actions.description: Executes SINGLEQUOTE formula to wrap selected text in single quotes.

actions.name: Reset ALL
actions.description: Resets [[...]] values to {{key}} placeholders across ALL YAML blocks in the document.

actions.name: CLEAR
actions.description: Resets [[...]] values to {{key}} placeholders in the first YAML block below the cursor.

actions.name: COPY
actions.description: Copies values from the first YAML block below the cursor, stripping [[ ]] brackets.
